result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers make Studio the recommended plan in the same ways: a 'Most popular' badge, a coloured border, a soft shadow and the only filled button. Prices lead every card in both, and the headings are large but don't overpower the Studio card. B's divider lines make the feature lists a little easier to scan and its Studio card is slightly enlarged, while A's grey outline buttons keep Starter and Network quieter than B's coloured outline buttons. These small differences cancel out. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): The two answers are very close. Both mark Studio with a 'Most popular' badge, a coloured border and a filled button, and both make the price the largest text in each card. A edges ahead because its Studio card sits taller than the other two, its feature list with dividers is tidy and has no extra description text, and its footer fits fully in view. B's grey outline buttons make Starter and Network a little quieter, but its large heading and the description paragraph in each card slightly weaken the hierarchy.
